reviews.t: Not really Wonder Clips, but at this price - so what?!
reviews.x: These are not really Wonder Clips (which are sold under the Clover brand name). Instead, they are "Handi Stitch Multi-Use Clips".  With that said, I have put a Wonder Clip next to a Multi-Use Clip and they are identical in dimensions and function - right down to the measuring marks on the back.  Placed next to one another, they are impossible to differentiate.  Where they DO differ is cost - I paid about 1/4 for these clips when compared to what I have been paying for Wonder Clips.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the clips as versatile, using them for far more than sewing, such as holding paper, music pages, glue-ups, and embroidery.
Many reviewers find the clips a safer and easier alternative to pins, especially for hemming and quilting.
Several reviewers highlight good quality and value, with some comparing them favorably to more expensive brands.
A few reviewers note the colors received differ from the photos, being pastel rather than the vibrant colors pictured.
One reviewer reports the clips failed to hold thin socks together during washing and drying and requested a refund.
